newsitem.title: LEBANON: BLC steady, Solidere mixed in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: BLC steady, Solidere mixed in Beirut.

text.p: Shares of Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce held steady and Solidere shares were mixed in higher turnover on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Wednesday.
BLC shares were unchanged from Monday's $12 when they were last traded, but turnover rose to 15,000 shares from 1,500.
BLC was the first bank to list on the Beirut exchange since the market reopened a year ago and up to Monday its shares had risen from $11.25 on January 2.

Solidere A shares were unchanged from Tuesday's $11.125 and B shares rose 1.1 percent to $11.5 from $11.375. Turnover in Solidere rose to 21,020 shares from 17,535 on Tuesday and value was $233,982.5 from $197,927.5.
There was no trade in the four other listed firms: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The LISPI stock index rose 0.14 percent to 81.72 and the BLOM stock index rose 0.47 percent to 945.78.
